sections.overview:
This skill guides development of hybrid smart contract MLM platforms that operate on both TRON and Ethereum blockchain networks simultaneously. The platform supports multiple compensation structures including hybrid binary and unilevel plans, allowing sponsors to earn from organizational volume across specified downline levels. Smart contracts automate commission calculations, transaction processing, and payment distribution while maintaining full decentralization and security against fraud. Businesses can customize fees, rewards, matrix plans, and user experiences across desktop and mobile interfaces. This approach helps MLM operators capture crypto users seeking passive income through transparent, blockchain-based earning mechanisms.
Launch a decentralized MLM platform earning commissions in both ETH and TRX
Implement hybrid binary-unilevel compensation structures with automated smart contract payouts
Create multi-blockchain MLM software with custom matrix plans and reward structures
Build fraud-resistant platforms with blockchain auditing for smart contract security
